purpose: Generic, read-only TagDuel pipeline that composes any committed positive LP-gain event with the Fire Princess trigger and returns one final LP tuple plus two idempotency ledgers.
upstream: M448 draw, M449 battle and M450 Standby source pipelines
contract: Validates that the declared LP gain equals the gaining team's before/after tuple delta.
Plans the source LP tuple against the current session snapshot.
Projects the post-gain LP tuple into a read-only TagDuel view for Fire Princess resolution.
Plans the Fire Princess damage tuple under a distinct namespaced event ID.
Returns the final LP tuple and both ledgers together without mutating game or player state.
Rejects partial ledger commits so a retry cannot apply a duplicate burn.
Duplicate retries return the current LP tuple unchanged.
Allows a source event to also change the opposing team's LP before Fire Princess resolves.
limitations: This is a reusable adapter pipeline, not central resolver registration or a database transaction implementation.
The trusted session layer must atomically persist the final LP tuple and both returned event ledgers.
No live Discord gateway, production database, merge or deployment is exercised.
